## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6b1bff8a27b59e0e94d94553cc08467c08740c3d`
Card: #31555 (claim 6724109493, amendment 6724431876) + #31558 (claim 6724119482, amendment 6724162761); dev reports 6724467344 / 6724475039 name this head
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the CEILINGS row that enforces the triage-duties.md ceiling; one row, 100 → 101). Read, not reviewed: rulings 6722123324 (rules 5–7) and 6184799323 (letter B), record 6722830741 item ⑤, `references/lanes/skills.md`:11–16, `references/lanes/devx.md`:7–10, `references/lanes/director.md`:72–78, `references/seat-lifecycle.md`:68, `references/seat-post-protocol.md`:31, `references/review-checklist.md`:18, SKILL.md:31 and :191, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`:276–278, `references/triage-duties.md`:70, AGENTS.md §Post-Task Checklist step 3 and the Tier S paragraph, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` header, `countLines`, `verdict`, `MAX_LINE_BYTES`/`classifyLine`, the `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` entry for `lanes/director.md` (was 70, source triage-duties.md 120), `.github/workflows/lint.yml`:1059–1062.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set and public surface: none moves. Three files, all internal rule text or its gate: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (1 line rewritten), `references/triage-duties.md` (+1 line), `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (one `CEILINGS` row and its comment). No package in any `files[]` is touched; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right.
- SKILL.md:313 (the claim template's `Skills-docs:` arm) now writes ruling 6722123324 rule 5 into the template: `updated here` covers `skills/**` only on a `domain:skills` PR, else that half is `follow-up #N`. Right: rule 5 bullet 4 (product-lane PRs do not edit `skills/**`; the product PR names the skills child) and `lanes/skills.md`:11–13 on `main` say exactly this; the template was the one reader-facing copy still saying the opposite. Measured: the line is 698 B before and after (wc −1 for the newline), SKILL.md stays 319/319, and the line sits inside the ```text fence, so the 120-byte rule is structurally exempt (`classifyLine` → `fence`). The word-diff shows six edits inside the line and nothing outside it; the four trims the body names are the ones in the diff (plus `this diff` → `the diff`, `the package's` → `its`). Readers of the line, each read at the head and still true: `review-checklist.md`:18 (line present and true; `follow-up owed` → `#N`), SKILL.md:191 (ACCEPT checks the line), `os-dev.md`:278 (spelling lives in the claim template), `seat-post-protocol.md`:31 (PR body through `issue_patch`). No parser: `git grep` of `updated here` over `.claude/`, `scripts/`, `AGENTS.md`, `.github/`, `packages/` at the head hits SKILL.md:313 alone; `Skills-docs` outside changesets/CHANGELOGs hits the four readers above and one comment in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`:861 naming a card, not a parser. Right. Past changesets that wrote `updated here — skills/...` on product PRs are history, not re-judged (the ruling's Execution: open cards are not re-laned mid-flight).
- triage-duties.md:10 writes rule 7's last bullet (「Triage shows these metrics in the daily dashboard's lane section」), the one ruled line record 6722830741 item ⑤ found homeless after PR #31552. Home judged right: rule 7 names triage; `lanes/director.md`:72–78 (每日摘要) has no lane section and lists other rows; `seat-lifecycle.md`:68 sends the five seat-health metrics there, a different list. The line points at `lanes/devx.md` 范围节度量行 (devx.md:8 is exactly that line) and restates none of the six. 115 B, under the 120-byte cap; the file ends with a newline, so `countLines` reads 101 = the new ceiling, headroom 0 as the row's comment says.
- `CEILINGS` row triage-duties.md 100 → 101: an ORDINARY letter-B raise (6184799323 item 1). Form held: the PR body quotes the ruling comment id (6722123324, rule 7) and the measured delta (+1, 100 → 101); the row moves by exactly that delta in the same PR; the row comment carries the ruling's sentence verbatim. Not a cross-file move and not a `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` destination, so no `ruledRaises` record applies. Side effect, computed from the map at the head: triage-duties.md is the declared SOURCE of the `lanes/director.md` move (was 120); its decrease is now 120 → 101 = 19 against that move's raise of 86 − 70 − 1 = 15 (condition a), and the map-wide total moves (86 − 71) + (101 − 120) = −4 (condition b). Both still hold; the gate agrees (below). Right.
- Gate verdicts on the head (check-runs on `6b1bff8a`, read 17:05Z–17:25Z, all completed at 17:25Z): 46 check-runs, 26 success, 20 skipped, 0 red. `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (job 128800768804) success with step `PM skill line ratchet` success — the ratchet step is `continue-on-error: true`, so the step conclusion was read, not inferred from the job; `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset`, `Test Core` (all 8 shards and the aggregate) success.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` label, no changeset file: right. The diff publishes nothing from any released package (AGENTS.md step 3: the label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package); `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` ship in no tarball. PR body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, matching both claims; `Check Changeset` success. Clause-②: no.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation 1 (L313 bytes paid by same-meaning trims inside L313): verified by word-diff; two trims leave a wording residue, graded below as nits (N1, N2). No reader edit was needed; checked above.
- Dev deviation 2 (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` row added by amendment 6724162761): the diff carries exactly what the amendment declares — one row, +1, comment citing 6722123324 — and nothing else in the script.
- Dev deviation 3 (42 derived gates measured at 57d986fb; only the ratchet family re-run after the `origin/main` merge): the check-runs on `6b1bff8a` are the gate verdicts here, not the local sweep; 0 red, ratchet step success at the head (①).
- Claim amendment 6724431876 (build tier `opus` under the no-Fable standing rule; the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review on the lane's isolated Fable reviewer): this record is that review; the dev's branch and the reviewing session are the pair signed below.
- Card #31555 「Not measured: whether any gate parses the `updated here` token」: measured at the head — none (①).
- Branch `claude/project-thread-436374` instead of `claude/issue-N-slug`: the claims name it a measured platform exception; recorded, not re-judged here.
- `open_questions`: none in either dev report; `out_of_scope_findings` empty. PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` ⇒ no 另记作者 note.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`:313 against card #31555's Ask and rule 5 on `main`. The change holds: the forbidden arm (`updated here` = taught in `skills/**` on any PR) is gone; `skills/**` is admitted only on `domain:skills` PRs; the else-branch is `follow-up #N`, rule 5's child card; `levels:` still points at the table that exists (AGENTS.md step 3: a kind ⇒ `minor`, `none` ⇒ `patch`); the seat's ACCEPT step and the `seat-post-protocol.md` PR-body line keep their referents. Trying to break it: a product-lane PR whose fix changes what authors are taught, with docs riding the PR, now reads `updated here` for the docs half and `follow-up #N` for the skills half, which is the card's own stated outcome; a `domain:skills` PR reads `updated here` as before. Two wording residues, neither of which admits an edit rule 5 forbids once `lanes/skills.md`:13 is read beside it:
- N1 (nit): the evals conjunct is outside the parenthetical. Every eval in the tree lives under `skills/*/evals/**` (29 directories at the head; `content/docs` has none — `references/identity/eval-user.mdx` is a page), so 「and its evals exercise it」 is itself a `skills/**` half, yet only the teaching half carries 「only on `domain:skills` PRs, else `follow-up #N`」. A product dev reading the conjunct as a to-do would add an eval under `skills/**`; `lanes/skills.md`:13 then moves the hunk to the child, so the contract is unaffected, but the template is the home of the spelling (`os-dev.md`:278) and could say it: e.g. 「(in `skills/**`, evals included, only on `domain:skills` PRs, else `follow-up #N`)」 (+17 B, payable in-line) or 「the skill's evals」 for the lost referent of `its` (was 「the package's」). Follow-up card or accepted deviation; no fix on this head.
- N2 (nit): dropping the two commas in 「a kind other than `none`, or a `(narrowing)` arm, owes」 leaves 「a kind other than `none` or a `(narrowing)` arm owes」, which also parses as 「other than (`none` or a narrowing arm)」, the inverse of the rule. Recoverable (a `(narrowing)` arm is a Clause-② arm, not a kind) and the three Chinese readers (`review-checklist.md`:18, `os-dev.md`:278, `triage-duties.md`:70) state 「非 `none` 或带 `(narrowing)` ⇒ 行在」 unambiguously. 2 B to restore when the line is next touched.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`:10 against card #31558's Ask and rule 7. The change holds: it is the ruled sentence, placed with the daily-fire duties (L8–9) where triage reads its daily layer, pointing at the one metric list instead of restating it, 115 B. Trying to break it: the only alternative homes (director.md 每日摘要, seat-lifecycle.md:68) are read and neither owns a lane section; the pointer `lanes/devx.md` 范围节度量行 resolves to devx.md:8; nothing in the file contradicts it.
- N3 (nit): 「每日看板」 — in this skill 看板 elsewhere means the org Project board (SKILL.md:31, `cross-repo-coordination.md`:40, `rest-channel.md`:69), and no file defines triage's daily dashboard artifact (triage's own comment 6722979582 calls it a triage-built artifact refreshed daily). The line follows the card's Chinese rendering of the ruling and the ruling presupposes the dashboard, so the gap is the ruling's, not the PR's; accepted deviation, or folded into a dashboard spec when one exists.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (implementing file) against letter B and the ratchet header, sentence by sentence: raise authorized by a ruling of record that orders text into the file — yes (6722123324 rule 7); PR body quotes the ruling id and the measured delta — yes; row moved by at most that delta in the same PR — yes (+1); no tolerance band used — count 101 = ceiling 101; landed count, headroom 0 — true at the head. The comment's claim 「no line of this file restates text another file carries」 is the dev's extra justification; letter B does not require it (deletion pays only for lines no ruling ordered), so it is not load-bearing and was not re-measured line by line.
- N4 (nit): the row comment says 「not a cross-file move」 but does not say the file is the SOURCE of the `lanes/director.md` move (was 120). This raise leaves that move 19 of decrease against +15; four more ordinary lines here (to 105) stay green, the fifth turns that move red. Informational for the next raiser; nothing to fix on this head.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none. Nits: N1–N4 (prose residues in the two `hits` files and one ratchet comment; none touches correctness or the contract; a fix to any of them moves the head, so they go to a follow-up card or are accepted as deviations).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-436374`

**VERDICT: PASS**
